title: USS Theodore Roosevelt Deploys From San Diego, USS Abraham Lincoln Near Hawaii
summary: Carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) quietly departed Sunday from San Diego to sail across the Pacific for what is expected to be an extended Middle East deployment, USNI News has learned. The carrier, the flagship of Carrier Strike Group 9, departed without the traditional pomp and circumstance – no sailors were spotted manning the rails, according to ship spotter photos. The carrier will embark with Carrier Air Wing 11. A defense official confirmed Theodore Roosevelt had begun its planned deployment. The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group is expected to move to U.S. Central Command to relieve the Japan-based USS George
author: Caitlyn Burchett
